question: Do the declared facts establish that f maps C to itself and f(x)=lambda*x for every x in C, for one nonzero scalar lambda? This implies that the restriction permutes C.
scalar_meaning: Multiplication by one element of the stated prime field, equivalently the corresponding integer scalar on the additive group.
interpretation: All arithmetic is modulo the stated prime p. f(x)=A*x+b. A full domain contains every vector; a line is all multiples of its declared generator. Opposite completion outcomes establish underdeclaration, not a population claim.
